newsitem.title: UK: PRESS DIGEST - London-based Arab newspapers - June 30.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - London-based Arab newspapers - June 30.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in two London-based Arabic-language newspapers on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Iran confirms its willingness to sign a defence pact with Gulf Arab states.
- Jordan says it will support government employees in buying shares at subsidised prices.
- Saudi investors to establish a $150 million investment holding company in Bahrain.
- A joint Saudi-Egyptian metal products firm is to offer its first production next week. It also plans an expansion project costing 10 million Egyptian pounds.
- Abu Dhabi's May foreign trade at 1.5 billion dirhams.
